headline: NBCC to merge with HSCC under Scheme of Arrangement; Regulation 37(6) intimation filed
sum: NBCC (India) Limited announced a Scheme of Arrangement for merger with HSCC (India) Limited, with intimation filed under SEBI LODR Regulation 37(6) on 18 July 2026. The scheme involves both companies' shareholders and creditors as parties to the arrangement.
detail: NBCC (India) Limited, a publicly listed infrastructure and engineering company, initiated a Scheme of Arrangement with HSCC (India) Limited, another listed entity. The intimation was filed with NSE under Regulation 37(6) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, confirming the scheme involves both companies' shareholders and creditors. A Scheme of Arrangement is the formal statutory vehicle under the Indian Companies Act for mergers requiring creditor protection or court sanction, indicating this transaction involves material creditor or structural considerations beyond a simple shareholder approval.
